risks.risk: Exact machine type/model is unclear, so correct parts/tooling and true market comparables can’t be confirmed.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the nameplate/serial/model plate (front + side angles) and any label near the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for an unknown industrial machine: assume reduced value due to missing/uncertain tooling/parts until model is confirmed.

risks.risk: “Tested yesterday” is not verifiable remotely; the machine may still fail under real production load (feeding/jam/misalignment).
risks.proof: Short video of a full production cycle (start → feed/operation → completion) showing stable output and no alarms.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: needs servicing/repair) until a load-test video is provided.

risks.risk: Japanese origin may be incorrect or rebranded.
risks.proof: Nameplate photo showing manufacturer and country; also stamped markings on motor/gearbox if visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without assuming Japanese origin (worst-case: generic/unknown origin).

risks.risk: Accessories/manual may be incomplete or missing.
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out clearly: every accessory/tooling/die and the manual(s) with labels.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories/manual until shown.

risks.risk: Safety/condition uncertainty (guards, wiring, emergency stop) can affect usability and cost of refurbishment.
risks.proof: Photos of emergency stop and all safety guards; plus a quick video showing emergency stop works.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with safety/condition uncertainty (worst-case: inspection/repairs needed).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the machine’s nameplate/serial/model plate (must be readable).
Send a video of the machine running under load for a complete cycle (not just power-on).
Send photos of all included accessories and the original manual laid out and labeled.
Send photos/videos of emergency stop and safety guards (and confirm they function).
response.reason: The seller’s reply is text-only and does not replace the missing remote evidence. Without a readable model/nameplate and a load-test video, the working condition and correct identity can’t be verified, so worst-case pricing is required until proof is provided.
